source: User-provided MedSafe_AI.zip, existing original-variant testing_results.csv files
method: Case-insensitive Levenshtein distance, micro-aggregated across identical aligned image IDs; medicine exact match casefold + normalized spaces
alignment: All 780 original-variant image IDs present in every engine; zero ground-truth label mismatches
limitations: Word-level medicine images only, not complete prescription fields
Historical TrOCR run is not the subsequent Notebook 44 fine-tuned checkpoint
Dosage, age validation and overdose classification not measured
Independent human re-adjudication and leakage validation not established
No claim that this satisfies final thesis acceptance criteria
